teaser.en: A forest giant with buttresses climbing its trunk, whose big plum-like fruit and oily seeds feed people and livestock alike.
teaser.sw: Jitu la msituni lenye mizizi-ukuta inayopanda juu ya shina lake, ambalo tunda lake kubwa kama plamu na mbegu zake zenye mafuta hulisha watu na mifugo pia.

summary.en: *Mkonga* is a large coastal forest tree with long buttresses and a fluted trunk, and big plum-like fruits. It gives food, seed oil, fodder and wood for stools, mortars and spoons, and intensive use has left it under threat.
summary.sw: *Mkonga* ni mti mkubwa wa msitu wa pwani wenye mizizi-ukuta mirefu na shina lenye mifereji, na matunda makubwa kama plamu. Hutoa chakula, mafuta ya mbegu, lishe ya mifugo na mbao za vigoda, vinu na miiko, na matumizi makubwa yameuweka hatarini.

about.en: *Mkonga* is a big tree. Long buttresses run up from the ground into a deeply fluted trunk, so the base looks like a cluster of walls. Each leaf is made of just two leaflets, a pattern typical of its genus. The fruit is large and plum-like.
about.sw: *Mkonga* ni mti mkubwa. Mizizi-ukuta mirefu hupanda kutoka ardhini hadi kwenye shina lenye mifereji mirefu, hivyo sehemu ya chini huonekana kama kundi la kuta. Kila jani limeundwa na vijani viwili tu, mpangilio wa kawaida wa jenasi yake. Tunda lake ni kubwa na linafanana na plamu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest. Look for the buttressed, fluted trunk, and for fallen fruit beneath it.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani. Tafuta shina lenye mizizi-ukuta na mifereji, na matunda yaliyoanguka chini yake.

uses.en:
The fruit is eaten, and oil is pressed from the seeds. The leaves serve as fodder for livestock.

The wood is used as timber and carved into stools, mortars and spoons.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake huliwa, na mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbegu. Majani hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo.

Mti wake hutumika kama mbao na huchongwa kuwa vigoda, vinu na miiko.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook agree on the Digo name *mkonga*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mkonga* or *mguguni*. There is no common English name.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanakubaliana juu ya jina la Kidigo *mkonga*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkonga* au *mguguni*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza.

conservation.en: Mkonga is threatened by intensive use for its wood and fruit.
conservation.sw: Mkonga uko hatarini kutokana na matumizi makubwa ya mbao na matunda yake.

reason.en: Forest tree with edible fruit and wood for mortars
reason.sw: Mti wa msituni wenye tunda linaloliwa na mbao za vinu

reason.en: Also carved into mortars and stools
reason.sw: Pia huchongwa kuwa vinu na vigoda

reason.en: Another tree valued for seed oil
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaothaminiwa kwa mafuta ya mbegu

reason.en: Fruit tree also used for stools and mortars
reason.sw: Mti wa matunda unaotumika pia kwa vigoda na vinu
